sovereign_country.strategic_role: 全球跨境基金设立第一大国、超大型跨国投资架构

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Publishing of Massively Multiplayer Online Role-Playing Games

applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Luxembourg–United States Double Taxation Convention (in force as amended)
Luxembourg–Germany Double Taxation Agreement (in force as amended)
Luxembourg–France Double Taxation Agreement (in force as amended)
BLEU–Hong Kong Investment Promotion and Protection Agreement (in force)
Treaty on the Functioning of the European Union (freedom of establishment and capital movement)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Law of 12 November 2004 on the fight against money laundering and terrorist financing, as amended; Law of 13 January 2019 on the Register of Beneficial Owners; CSSF Regulation 19-01 and related grand-ducal implementing regulations.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copy of passport or national ID of each direct shareholder and UBO
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Passport/identity authority in country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille OR consular legalization if issued outside Luxembourg; no apostille required for EU/EEA official acts

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copy of incorporation instrument and trade register extract of any corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent companies register in the jurisdiction of incorporation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille + notarized translation into French or German; consular legalization for non-Hague states

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank certificate or attorney-file confirmation evidencing payment/release of subscription amount for share capital
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Luxembourg credit institution or notary's blocked account
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Domestic Luxembourg instrument, notarization by the drafting notary; no apostille required

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all shareholders, UBOs, directors and managers against the EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, UN Security Council Consolidated List, OFAC SDN List, and Luxembourg's national sanctions list. PEPs are subject to enhanced due diligence under Article 7 of the Law of 12 November 2004, including source-of-wealth verification; any match or suspicious fact must be reported to the Cellule de Renseignement Financier (CRF/FIU).

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Luxembourg Business Registers (LBR) – Registre de Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS), https://www.lbr.lu
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Company names must be submitted in the Latin alphabet and may use French, German, Luxembourgish, or English derivatives; non-Latin scripts must be transliterated into Latin script with a certified French or German translation. The name may not mislead as to the legal form, purpose, or a regulated activity, and must be unique in the RCS database.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: No extension of the 60-day reservation is available; after expiry, the name may be reserved again with a new application. If the Registry rejects or conditions a name, the applicant may file a formal request for reconsideration with the Registrar within 15 days of the decision; a subsequent judicial appeal lies to the President of the Tribunal d'Arrondissement de Luxembourg sitting in summary proceedings, with mandatory representation by a Luxembourg-bar lawyer.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A registered office may be a virtual office or registered-agent address physically located in Luxembourg, provided the notarial deed of incorporation designates that address. For ISIC 5820 MMORPG publishing, such an arrangement is acceptable at the RCS level but creates heightened commercial-substance risk; the Luxembourg tax administration may require economic activity, employees, and decision-making in Luxembourg to honor treaty benefits.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Estimated 10% probability of unannounced on-site inspection in the first year if a physical office with rational substance exists; rises to approximately 30% probability when only a virtual office/registered agent address is used, especially if turnover is generated through high-volume digital sales.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Name reservation and availability/transliteration check through LBR portal
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Luxembourg Business Registers and/or authorised service provider
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory filing fee plus prevailing market handling fee

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Drafting, review and notarial execution of Articles of Association and incorporation deed
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for notarial tariffs (tarif notarial)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: RCS registration fee and publication of incorporation in the Recueil des Sociétés et Associations
AML/CFT UBO verification, PEP/sanctions screening and compliance file preparation
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Luxembourg law firm or registered compliance agent

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarized translations, apostilles or consular legalization of foreign corporate and personal documents
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Certified translator and competent authorities of document origin
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Service provider quotation based on number of documents

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: First-year virtual office/registered agent service and statutory books/register maintenance setup
Pre-incorporation share capital holding account attestation and release instructions
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Bank/notary fee schedule for capital confirmation certificate

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Luxembourg Law of 10 August 1915 on Commercial Companies, as amended (Company Law), Articles 1-6 (formation), 11-12 (minimum capital), 17-23 (Articles of Association), 25-28 (shareholders' meetings), and 67-70 (managers of SARL); Law of 19 December 2002 on the Register of Commerce and Companies and Recueil électronique des sociétés
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registre de Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS) – Luxembourg Business Registers, operated under the Luxembourg Ministry of Justice
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Articles of Association (Statuts) executed before a Luxembourg notary and the RCS incorporation filing application (demande d'immatriculation), together with the certificate of deposit of share capital (attestation de blocage de fonds)
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: SARL minimum nominal share capital is EUR 12,000, fully subscribed and paid up in cash or in kind. The cash portion must be deposited into a blocked escrow account held by an approved Luxembourg credit institution; the bank's fund blockage certificate is required before RCS registration and remains blocked until the incorporation is published in the Recueil électronique des sociétés.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED: (1) The incorporation of the company as a Luxembourg SARL with share capital of EUR 12,000, fully paid up through a blocked escrow deposit, is hereby approved and ratified; the Articles of Association as notarized are accepted. (2) All share subscriptions are accepted and the shares are allotted to the founding shareholders in accordance with the capital deposit certificate. (3) The registered office is fixed at [Address], Luxembourg, Grand Duchy of Luxembourg, and the RCS registration is authorised. (4) [Full Name] is appointed sole gérant (manager) with power to operate the company, sign all filings, and instruct counsel; any co-managers are jointly and severally vested accordingly. This resolution is effective forthwith.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Deposit of Share Capital in Blocked Escrow Account
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Approved Luxembourg credit institution or notary client escrow account; banking supervision by the Luxembourg Financial Sector Supervisory Commission (Commission de Surveillance du Secteur Financier, CSSF)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a temporary share capital account in the name of the future SARL or in the notary’s client escrow account. Transfer no less than EUR 12,000 from the shareholders. Instructions to the bank must expressly block the account until RCS registration. Obtain the fund blockage certificate (attestation de blocage) naming all subscribers and confirming the exact amount.
required_dossiers: Passports or national identity cards of founding shareholders
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the credit institution requires further KYC/AML documentation, provide notarized ID, bank references, and an updated corporate structure chart. If the deposit is refused, re-route funds through the notary's escrow account or select another CSSF-approved institution.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Notarial Execution of Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Luxembourg notary public (notaire), appointed by the shareholders and supervised by the Minister of Justice
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: All founding shareholders appear before the notary, personally or through notarized proxies, and execute the final Articles of Association. The notary verifies the legality of the articles, the identity and legal capacity of the shareholders, the capital deposit certificate, and the registered office address. The notary then certifies the deed (acte constitutif) and transmits it electronically to the RCS.
required_dossiers: Proof of registered office address (lease or ownership title)
Declaration of equity ownership and authorized representatives
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary issues a legal query concerning the articles or the registered office, submit amended articles and a supplementary notarial deed within 15 business days. If the issue cannot be cured, repeat the notarial execution with corrected documents.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Filing with the Luxembourg Trade and Companies Register (RCS)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registre de Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS) – Luxembourg Business Registers, e-justice portal (rcl.lu)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the application for registration via the RCS electronic filing system. The notary uploads the notarial deed, statutory declarations, and the registered office form. The RCS verifies the company name, SARL legal form, minimum capital, and compliance of the articles. Upon acceptance, the RCS assigns the corporate registration number (numéro RCS).
required_dossiers: Declaration of non-disqualification of the manager
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the RCS raises an objection (e.g., name conflict or missing declaration), file a corrective declaration within 5 business days. If registration is refused, submit an administrative review request to the RCS registrar or re-file after curing the defect.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Publication in the Luxembourg Official Electronic Gazette (RES)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Recueil électronique des sociétés (RES) – operated by the Luxembourg Ministry of Justice and the RCS
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After RCS registration, the RCS publishes the incorporation summary and the articles in the RES. The publication invoice and RCS fees are settled. The company receives the official publication certificate. Upon publication, the company obtains full legal personality and the bank releases the blocked share capital to the active operating account.
required_dossiers: Publication notice approved by the notary
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the RES publication contains errors, file a rectification request with the RCS and resubmit a corrected synopsis. If publication is delayed, contact the RES support desk and obtain written acknowledgment of the publication date.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Formation VAT, Business Licensing, and Employer Registrations
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Administration de l'enregistrement, des domaines et de la TVA (VAT), Administration des contributions directes (direct tax), Ministry of the Economy (business licensing through Guichet unique), and Centre commun de la sécurité sociale (social security)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Register for Luxembourg corporate income tax, municipal business tax, net wealth tax, and VAT; obtain a VAT identification number. Apply for the autorisation d'établissement if commercial or business premises activities are exercised. Register with the social security center for employer obligations, and with the CNPD if personal data processing occurs in connection with the MMORPG platform. Open the final operating bank account after receipt of publication certificate.
required_dossiers: Notarial deed and Articles of Association
Lease contract or ownership deed for registered office
Passport and clean criminal record extract of the manager
Employer registration declaration for social security
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the business license application is queried based on the manager's professional qualifications, file a waiver request or appoint a qualified professional manager. If VAT registration is delayed, contact the VAT Administration and submit a copy of the RCS certificate to expedite the formalities.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministry of the Economy of Luxembourg (Direction de l'industrie) and the municipal authorities (Commune) for premises-related approvals; single point of contact is the Guichet unique business portal
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Autorisation d'établissement (Business Establishment Authorization) and occupational premises permit for office and server-room operations

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Administration de l'environnement (Luxembourg Environmental Protection Agency)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt — non-polluting software publishing and digital office activities fall under Category C (enrollment only); no Full EIA Report required for MMORPG development and publishing
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Compliance with Luxembourg air-quality and wastewater discharge standards per the Luxembourg environmental code; waste handling and equipment disposal must comply with the EU Waste Electrical and Electronic Equipment Directive 2012/19/EU and the Luxembourg waste management regulations; office ventilation and heating systems must meet the Grand Ducal Regulation on technical installation standards for indoor workplaces.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certification from the communal fire brigade after inspection of evacuation routes, alarm systems, and extinguisher placement; structural load inspection certificate for server and equipment rooms; occupational welfare clearance through the Inspection du Travail et des Mines (ITM) confirming workstations, lighting, microclimate, and first-aid provisions meet Luxembourg labor law.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Administration des contributions directes (Direct Tax Administration) for corporate income tax and net wealth tax; Administration de l'enregistrement, des domaines et de la TVA (AEDT) for VAT, registration duties, and indirect tax; unified e-portal: MyGuichet.lu / guichet.lu and AEDT portal (aedt.public.lu).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: For a Luxembourg SARL: (1) incorporate before a notary and file with the Luxembourg Trade and Companies Register (RCS) to obtain the national business number (numéro d'identification / matricule); (2) the RCS registration automatically triggers the attribution of the corporate income tax number; (3) submit the VAT registration form (Formulaire 640/641) to AEDT within 15 days after the first taxable transaction; the central VAT number (LU + 8 digits) is issued within approximately 15-20 working days. For a non-resident entity without a Luxembourg permanent establishment, direct VAT registration with AEDT is required before cross-border B2C digital supplies are made, or the EU OSS scheme may be used for intra-EU B2C digital services.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Luxembourg SARL is subject to entity-level corporate income tax (IRC), municipal business tax (ICB), and net wealth tax; no check-the-box pass-through election exists. Available elections include: (1) VAT grouping election (assujetti unique) under the AEDT for related taxable persons; (2) corporate income tax fiscal unity election (intégration fiscale) under Article 164bis LIR for a Luxembourg parent and one or more 95%+ Luxembourg subsidiaries; (3) hybrid mismatch elections in accordance with ATAD-compliant rules, where applicable, to adjust the tax treatment of a transparent entity or reverse hybrid.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: EUR 35,000 (annual turnover, excluding VAT, for the Luxembourg small-business exemption); EUR 10,000 for intra-EU distance sales of goods (unless the supplier opts to apply Luxembourg VAT); no threshold for non-resident suppliers of digital services to Luxembourg B2C customers.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Luxembourg does not currently mandate real-time fiscal clearance, continuous transaction controls (CTC), or digital tax stamping. Electronic invoicing is accepted under the VAT law, subject to authenticity of origin and integrity of content (PCI compliance), and B2G e-invoicing is mandatory in Luxembourg public procurement via PEPPOL. There is no mandatory API submission for individual invoices to the tax authority; periodic VAT returns and recapitulative statements are filed electronically via AEDT systems.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: 0% VAT applies to the export of goods to a destination outside the EU, provided the goods physically leave the EU within 90 days from the time of supply (standard practice) and supported by documentary proofs. Supplies of software and digital services to non-EU B2B customers are outside the scope of Luxembourg VAT (place of supply is the customer's country); digital B2C services to non-EU customers are also outside Luxembourg VAT as the effective use and enjoyment is outside the EU. For B2B exported services inside the EU, reverse-charge rules apply, not zero-rating.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (electronic via PLDA/AES, including MRN and Exit Summary Declaration)
Bill of Lading or Airway Bill (or other transport evidence proving physical departure from the EU)
Inward Remittance Certificate (supplementary evidence of payment repatriation for the audit file; not a statutory prerequisite for zero-rating in Luxembourg)
Commercial invoice and contract documents evidencing delivery terms (Incoterms)
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The AEDT may verify export proofs and, where zero-rating is claimed without adequate documentary evidence, issue a VAT assessment for the gross amount (clawback) plus default interest at 0.6% per month. Administrative fines for under-declared VAT or irregular export/zero-rating claims range from EUR 125 to EUR 5,000, and in cases of tax fraud a further fine of up to 20% of the tax evaded may be imposed; criminal penalties for deliberate VAT fraud can reach imprisonment (up to 5 years) and monetary fines up to EUR 500,000. Limitation periods are 5 years for reassessment (10 years in case of fraud or concealment).

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual financial statements (balance sheet, profit and loss account, annex) approved by the ordinary general meeting and filed at the Register of Commerce and Companies
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Luxembourg Trade and Companies Register (RCS - Registre de Commerce et des Sociétés)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: General meeting approval within six months of the balance-sheet date; filing at RCS within one month of approval; for a 31 December fiscal year-end the final filing deadline is 31 July of the following year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late or non-filing triggers court summons and fines up to EUR 25,000; two consecutive failures may entail judicial strike-off; the gérant is exposed to personal liability for resulting damages

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: UBO annual verification: confirmation that previously filed beneficial-ownership data remain accurate or a change notice; not a separate statutory form
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: RCS - Register of Beneficial Owners (Registre des Bénéficiaires Effectifs)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Change notice within one month of any UBO change; annual verification is processed during the 31 July annual-account filing cycle
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative fines of up to EUR 250,000 under the Luxembourg AML/CFT law; wilful false declarations expose officers and the company to criminal sanctions

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual corporate income tax return package (IRC, net wealth tax IFT and municipal business tax ICC declared through the ACD forms)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within five months after the end of the fiscal year; for a calendar-year SARL the filing is due by 31 May; extension is available only upon reasoned pre-filing request
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing fines of EUR 300-EUR 3,000; monthly default interest on unpaid taxes; estimated assessment may eliminate favourable deductions; deliberate non-filing can attract criminal tax penalties

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual general meeting convening, minuting and, where applicable, RCS filing of any gérant appointment or removal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Company books and records; RCS for publication of manager changes
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Ordinary general meeting must be held within six months of each balance-sheet date; manager appointments/removals must be published at RCS within one month of the decision
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to hold the meeting may allow shareholders to petition the court to convene it; non-publication of manager changes is ineffective against third parties and may attract RCS fines

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory audit is triggered where a SARL exceeds at least two of these three criteria in two consecutive years: total assets above EUR 4,400,000; net turnover above EUR 8,800,000; average headcount above 50. Such companies must appoint a Luxembourg-approved statutory auditor (réviseur d'entreprises agréé).
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Luxembourg GAAP implemented by the Law of 19 December 2002 (transposing EU Accounting Directive 2013/34/EU); IFRS as adopted by the EU may be used by an unlisted SARL only on an opt-in basis and is not mandatory.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Luxembourg does not impose a separate annual UBO confirmation filing; the RCS requires UBO information to be filed on incorporation and any change to be filed within one month of operation and knowledge. The 31 July annual-account filing window is used as the standard annual checkpoint for verifying that stored UBO data remains correct.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Shareholder register (registre des actionnaires) recording all part sociale holdings and ownership events
Register of gérants (manager) appointments, acceptances and resignations
Minute book of shareholders' meetings and board/manager decisions, including approved resolutions and conflict-of-interest declarations

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 15% CIT (IRC, 2025 rate) + 7% solidarity surcharge (=1.05%) + municipal business tax (Luxembourg City 6.75%) = 22.80% combined headline rate; municipal business tax varies by commune (0% to 10.75%)
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: IP box under Art. 50bis LIR: 80% exemption of net qualifying IP income, subject to nexus ratio; Participation exemption: 100% exemption on qualifying dividends and capital gains (>=10% shareholding or >=EUR 1.2m acquisition cost; 12-month holding; subject-to-tax test); R&D tax credit of 20% of eligible R&D expenditures; unlimited loss carryforward subject to annual minimum taxation rule
